We will strategically use a variety of methods such as article reading, drilling, focused exercises and other techniques in order to improve your pronunciation and make you sound more like a native speaker.

Each lesson will include full corrections and sometimes homework will be given to continue developing your practice in your own time!

--------------------------------------------

We will use a progressive system of practice exercises to get you familiar with a range of English scenarios in the form of texts, scripts, videos, lectures and more. 

You can book this lesson and simply let me know whether you would prefer to do Pronunciation OR Listening practice, or if you book a package of lessons you can mix up between the two freely.

I pride myself on being a relaxed and easy going teacher, so you can feel free to message me if you have any questions.

Have a great day.

pro_course_detail.title: Discuss the News (with a native British English teacher!)
pro_course_detail.description:
Let's discuss the news!

For this lesson I will chose an interesting article based on your preferences (general news, entertainment, celebrity gossip, sports news, health, technology etc!) and either send it to you to read before the lesson, or to read out loud during the class to focus on pronunciation and reading skills. 

We will use the article during the lesson firstly to work on your reading skills, before discussing the topic together and expressing our views, so that you can practise giving your opinions on a wide variety of topics. 

Full corrections will be given, you can feel free to have a cup of tea with me whilst we enjoy a relaxed discussion :-) 

I look forward to discussing the news with you soon!

pro_course_detail.title: Proofreading / Proofing  - Learn to write like a native! - Corrections, native check, improvements - *NOT a Skype/Zoom lesson*
pro_course_detail.description:
Perhaps you're taking an exam and want to know if your speaking notes or writing practice are correct? Maybe you have written an essay, dissertation or article for work? A personal statement for an application?

Whatever the reason your writing is for, I can help you make it sound authentic and correct!

I will offer full corrections including grammar, spelling and structure, as well as improvements and suggestions, using tracked changes and highlighting what has been done.

*Please note that although you have to select a time for this lesson, this will NOT take place over Skype or Zoom. We will agree on a time / date that the proofing must be completed by, and I will send the fully annotated document back to you.
If there are no suitable times available on my schedule - MESSAGE ME - and I will open times for you. I am always happy to help*

For 500 words, please book the 30 minute lesson.
For 501-1000 words, please book the 60 minute lesson.
For anything longer than 1000 words, please contact me directly, or simply book multiple lessons here to make up the total word count.

If you have any further questions please feel free to ask.

pro_course_detail.title: Sherlock Holmes / Harry Potter / Game of Thrones etc - Script OR Story reading lesson / Role play :-)
pro_course_detail.description:
This is an incredibly fun lesson designed to help you improve your English speaking ability, through the use of your favourite TV show, movie and book scripts and scenes!

There are 2 options for this lesson :

1. You will read one of the Harry Potter books (I will send you this once you purchase the lesson pack) out loud in our class. Full corrections will be given, and discussion about the book and your opinions will take place :-) 
2. We will both play the role of characters in a certain story, and will each read our lines, voicing the specific role. 

This lesson is incredibly effective for improving your pronunciation, intonation, tone, and more - all whilst having SO MUCH FUN!!!!!! :-)

Please feel free to suggest a scene or piece of dialogue from your favourite movie or book, or allow me to choose one and surprise you!

If you have any questions, please feel free to ask.

Let's work together to design the perfect and most fun lesson for you!

I look forward to role playing some scenes with you soon :-)

course_info.trial_description: In this trial lesson, we will go over both your expectations and my style of teaching to see if we can work together in order to reach your goals! 30 minutes is the perfect amount of time for us both to have a feel for each other and understand what we could do together!

pro_course_detail.title: English language - grammar practice: present simple vs. present continuous
pro_course_detail.description: Let's practise the differences between present simple and present continuous! We will look at how and when to use the 2 different tenses with some simple exercises for practice. Ideal for first-time learners or students that need to refresh this grammar point.

pro_course_detail.title: English language - grammar practice: past simple vs. past continuous
pro_course_detail.description: Past simple vs. past continuous: the student learns the main differences between the two, understands how to use the grammar, and then practises using it! There is also an emphasis on recognising which one is correct in any given context. What's more, there is a review (if needed) on the use of the prepositions 'when' and 'while', and how to use them together with past simple/continuous.

pro_course_detail.title: English language - grammar practice: introducing present perfect (simple)
pro_course_detail.description: Together, we will look at what present perfect is and how to use it in the correct context! This grammatical tense is often confused by L2 students, so it needs to be understood. Once we have gone over the grammar and functions of present perfect, the student can then write examples of their own! Other exercises include: understanding the differences between present perfect and past simple, identifying when to use present perfect and past simple, and how to use present perfect and past simple together; this includes in positive/negative sentences and question form.

pro_course_detail.title: English language - grammar practice: review of the 4 conditionals
pro_course_detail.description: Whether you've studied these before, or if it's your first time looking at the 4 English conditionals, no problem! Together we will look through them an understand how and when to use them in the right context! Not only this, but we will have an in-depth look at the grammatical structures with specific board work that you can use to take your time and understand (this is the most important thing!). When we are happy with the grammar, we will then do some examples and exercises together for further understanding. Once you have learnt the conditionals, your English will never be the same again!

pro_course_detail.title: English language - speaking: pronunciation practice
pro_course_detail.description: English is famously difficult at times with its non-phonetic pronunciation. That doesn't have to be an obstacle for you, though! In the time we spend together, we will look at some important pronunciations of very basic things, such as UK vs. USA pronunciation, common mispronunciations, confusing word endings and how to say them (-ough endings, for example), tricky silent letters and how to identify them, and much, much more! With the right guidance, you will have more confidence in your ability to speak everyday English words, and, in time, you'll use your spoken English to better effect, too!

pro_course_detail.title: English language - vocabulary building
pro_course_detail.description: My students often feel frustrated when they have a 'mind blank moment' and either can't remember a word, or don't know a certain form of a word. This session is designed to help you build your vocabulary some more so that you don't feel embarrassed or annoyed when speaking. English has an incredibly rich range of vocabulary, so let's look together at what I like to call 'language family trees' - what does that mean? It's looking at how verbs, nouns, adjectives and adverbs are all connected. This also means that you will build your vocabulary by associating these words. We can also look at common prefixes and suffixes, as well as tricky irregular verbs with strange 2nd and 3rd forms! In short, your vocabulary will grow and give you more confidence with your English, it doesn't matter if you're beginner, intermediate, or advanced: words mean confidence!
